verses.en: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
verses.pt: Depois disse o Senhor a Noé: Entra na arca, tu e toda a tua casa, porque tenho visto que és justo diante de mim nesta geração.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Noah, Take all your family and go into the ark, for you only in this generation have I seen to be upright.

verses.en: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
verses.pt: De todos os animais limpos levarás contigo sete e sete, o macho e sua fêmea; mas dos animais que não são limpos, dois, o macho e sua fêmea;
verses.en_web: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.
verses.en_bbe: Of every clean beast you will take seven males and seven females, and of the beasts which are not clean, two, the male and his female;

verses.en: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
verses.pt: também das aves do céu sete e sete, macho e fêmea, para se conservar em vida sua espécie sobre a face de toda a terra.
verses.en_web: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And of the birds of the air, seven males and seven females, so that their seed may still be living on the face of the earth.

verses.en: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
verses.pt: Porque, passados ainda sete dias, farei chover sobre a terra quarenta dias e quarenta noites, e exterminarei da face da terra todas as criaturas que fiz.
verses.en_web: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
verses.en_bbe: For after seven days I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, for the destruction of every living thing which I have made on the face of the earth.

verses.en: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
verses.pt: E Noé fez segundo tudo o que o Senhor lhe ordenara.
verses.en_web: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.
verses.en_bbe: And Noah did everything which the Lord said he was to do.

verses.en: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.pt: Tinha Noé seiscentos anos de idade, quando o dilúvio veio sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And Noah was six hundred years old when the waters came flowing over all the earth.

verses.en: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
verses.pt: Noé entrou na arca com seus filhos, sua mulher e as mulheres de seus filhos, por causa das águas do dilúvio.
verses.en_web: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
verses.en_bbe: And Noah, with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives, went into the ark because of the flowing of the waters.

verses.en: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
verses.pt: Dos animais limpos e dos que não são limpos, das aves, e de todo réptil sobre a terra,
verses.en_web: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
verses.en_bbe: Of clean beasts, and of beasts which are not clean, and of birds, and of everything which goes on the earth,

verses.en: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.pt: entraram dois a dois para junto de Noé na arca, macho e fêmea, como Deus ordenara a Noé.
verses.en_web: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
verses.en_bbe: In twos, male and female, they went into the ark with Noah, as God had said.

verses.en: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.pt: Passados os sete dias, vieram sobre a terra as águas do dilúvio.
verses.en_web: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And after the seven days, the waters came over all the earth.

verses.en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.pt: No ano seiscentos da vida de Noé, no mês segundo, aos dezessete dias do mês, romperam-se todas as fontes do grande abismo, e as janelas do céu se abriram,
verses.en_web: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.
verses.en_bbe: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, all the fountains of the great deep came bursting through, and the windows of heaven were open;

verses.en: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.pt: e caiu chuva sobre a terra quarenta dias e quarenta noites.
verses.en_web: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.en_bbe: And rain came down on the earth for forty days and forty nights.

verses.en: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
verses.pt: Nesse mesmo dia entrou Noé na arca, e juntamente com ele seus filhos Sem, Cão e Jafé, como também sua mulher e as três mulheres de seus filhos,
verses.en_web: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—
verses.en_bbe: On the same day Noah, with Shem, Ham, and Japheth, his sons, and his wife and his sons' wives, went into the ark;

verses.en: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.pt: e com eles todo animal segundo a sua espécie, todo o gado segundo a sua espécie, todo réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra segundo a sua espécie e toda ave segundo a sua espécie, pássaros de toda qualidade.
verses.en_web: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.en_bbe: And with them, every sort of beast and cattle, and every sort of thing which goes on the earth, and every sort of bird.

verses.en: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
verses.pt: Entraram para junto de Noé na arca, dois a dois de toda a carne em que havia espírito de vida.
verses.en_web: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
verses.en_bbe: They went with Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh in which is the breath of life.

verses.en: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
verses.pt: E os que entraram eram macho e fêmea de toda a carne, como Deus lhe tinha ordenado; e o Senhor o fechou dentro.
verses.en_web: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.
verses.en_bbe: Male and female of all flesh went in, as God had said, and the ark was shut by the Lord.

verses.en: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
verses.pt: Veio o dilúvio sobre a terra durante quarenta dias; e as águas cresceram e levantaram a arca, e ela se elevou por cima da terra.
verses.en_web: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And for forty days the waters were over all the earth; and the waters were increased so that the ark was lifted up high over the earth.

verses.en: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.pt: Prevaleceram as águas e cresceram grandemente sobre a terra; e a arca vagava sobre as águas.
verses.en_web: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
verses.en_bbe: And the waters overcame everything and were increased greatly on the earth, and the ark was resting on the face of the waters.

verses.en: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
verses.pt: As águas prevaleceram excessivamente sobre a terra; e todos os altos montes que havia debaixo do céu foram cobertos.
verses.en_web: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
verses.en_bbe: And the waters overcame everything on the earth; and all the mountains under heaven were covered.

verses.en: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.pt: Quinze côvados acima deles prevaleceram as águas; e assim foram cobertos.
verses.en_web: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
verses.en_bbe: The waters went fifteen cubits higher, till all the mountains were covered.

verses.en: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
verses.pt: Pereceu toda a carne que se movia sobre a terra, tanto ave como gado, animais selvagens, todo réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra, e todo homem.
verses.en_web: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
verses.en_bbe: And destruction came on every living thing moving on the earth, birds and cattle and beasts and everything which went on the earth, and every man.

verses.en: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
verses.pt: Tudo o que tinha fôlego do espírito de vida em suas narinas, tudo o que havia na terra seca, morreu.
verses.en_web: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
verses.en_bbe: Everything on the dry land, in which was the breath of life, came to its end.

verses.en: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
verses.pt: Assim foram exterminadas todas as criaturas que havia sobre a face da terra, tanto o homem como o gado, o réptil, e as aves do céu; todos foram exterminados da terra; ficou somente Noé, e os que com ele estavam na arca.
verses.en_web: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
verses.en_bbe: Every living thing on the face of all the earth, man and cattle and things moving on the face of the earth, and birds of the air, came to destruction: only Noah and those who were with him in the ark, were kept from death.

verses.en: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
verses.pt: E prevaleceram as águas sobre a terra cento e cinqüenta dias.
verses.en_web: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
verses.en_bbe: And the waters were over the earth a hundred and fifty days.
